# Catskill Farms

> > Catskill Farms is a custom home builder specializing in modern farmhouses, barn homes, and ranches across Ulster, Sullivan, and Dutchess Counties in the Hudson Valley and Catskills region of Upstate New York.

Founded by Charles Petersheim with over 20 years of experience, Catskill Farms has built 300+ homes and developed multiple residential projects. The company serves the NYC weekend home market with curated new construction and custom building services.
